将原图进行高清画质修复与清晰度增强，仅提升画面质量，不改变画面风格、人物风格及整体视觉效果。严格保持原始画面内容、主体姿态、人物身份、五官特征、服装款式、构图、背景环境、光影关系和色彩氛围不变，不新增、不删减、不替换任何物体或细节，也不进行风格化重绘。

仅对画面进行高质量修复与细节还原，重点改善分辨率与清晰度，增强皮肤质感、发丝边缘、布料纹理和环境细节，同时去除噪点、模糊、压缩痕迹、网格感、脏污色块及轻微瑕疵，使画面更加干净、自然、清晰，但整体风格、人物风格和原始观感保持不变。

Subject & Action:
A cute young woman in a classic Japanese sailor-style school uniform, striking a cool action pose aimed directly at the viewer. She firmly grips a brightly colored toy bubble gun with both hands, arms extended forward—left arm locked straight at eye level, right arm slightly bent, elbows tucked—tilting her head just a fraction, gaze sharp yet playful through the lens of her round glasses, as if about to unleash a bubbly ambush. Her body is naturally full and voluptuous, with a well-proportioned, curvaceous silhouette that is plump and feminine without any belly bulge or excess fat. Her limbs are soft yet solid: her upper arms and thighs are thick, toned and rounded, conveying a healthy, athletic cuteness rather than slim fragility.

Face & Hairstyle & Accessories:
She has a round, doll-like adorable face with soft, pinchable cheeks and a subtle natural flush. Her glossy jet-black hair is styled in a neat shoulder-length bob, straight bangs resting just above her eyebrows, ends curling slightly inward. She wears a pair of silver-framed thin-rimmed round glasses with clear lenses, behind which her bright, lively eyes sparkle with a mischievous glint. A tiny, sweetly crooked smile lifts one corner of her mouth. Her skin is exquisitely detailed: fine, tender, baby-smooth flesh with realistic ultra-high-definition skin texture—visible micro-pores, faint translucent vellus hairs, and natural skin creasing at the joints of her thick, sturdy arms and legs, rendered with hyper-realistic precision.

Costume & Prop Details:
The sailor uniform consists of a white square-collar top with navy piping and a deep navy pleated skirt falling just above the knee; a red ribbon bow tied at the collar flutters lightly with her motion. The thick pleats of the skirt ripple in soft, heavy folds, emphasizing the fullness of her hips and the solidity of her plump thighs. The bubble gun is vintage-styled, molded in pastel pink and mint green plastic, with a translucent soap solution reservoir glowing faintly. From the flared muzzle, a stream of delicate iridescent bubbles floats outward, refracting tiny rainbow halos. She wears white ankle socks and black round-toe uniform shoes, planted firmly on the ground, the thick muscles of her calves subtly tensed.

Scene & Environment:
The setting is a school athletic track under a clear open sky. The red polyurethane running track stretches beneath her feet, its granular textured surface sharply detailed with tiny rubber particles and faint white lane markings. In the blurred background, white lane lines curve gently, and metal hurdles painted in faded blue stand idle on the inner field. Beyond the track, soft-focused school buildings with clean white walls and large windows rise against a backdrop of distant green trees, their leaves catching the light. A gentle breeze stirs a few stray cherry blossom petals drifting across the track.

Lighting & Atmosphere:
Afternoon sunlight, warm and diffused, pours down from the upper left, casting soft, natural highlights on her face, glasses, and the gloss of her uniform. The lighting sculpts the full roundness of her arms and thighs, emphasizing the realistic skin texture: the subtle sheen of fine pores, the delicate shadows in the creases of her elbows and knees. Sunlight catches the drifting bubbles, turning them into tiny floating prisms. The mood is youthful, spirited, and playfully cool—an energetic freeze-frame with a crisp, airy ambiance.

Quality & Composition:
Hyper-realistic, photorealistic rendering with extreme attention to natural skin detail: realistic dermal texture, visible goosebumps, subtle veins faintly traced beneath the surface of her thick, soft arms and hands. Cinematic shallow depth of field, subject placed slightly off-center to the right, captured from a low-angle upward perspective to emphasize her presence and the confident, playful stance. Background moderately blurred with creamy bokeh, keeping environmental context readable but focus razor-sharp on her face, glasses, and the bubble gun. Color palette balanced and natural—medium-warm tones, soft contrast, subtle film-grain micro-texture—achieving an ultra-realistic, tangible photographic look, as if captured with a high-end portrait lens.
